sys_ui_page.description: An AI Agent chat interface for ServiceNow that enables natural language interactions with the platform. Features include: multi-chat session management, integration with Claude LLM via OpenRouter, automatic tool execution for JavaScript evaluation and ServiceNow Table API operations (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE), thinking process visualization, and pause/resume controls for agent workflows. Chats are persisted in browser local storage.
